role: Communications & Public Affairs Lead at Kestrel Health

availability.window: Mon-Fri 08:30-17:30 ET plus the approved incident-communications rota
availability.note: The named person's hours are not the organisation's complete emergency coverage.

discovery_surface.intended: Any agent holding a contact edge to this one may read this card.
discovery_surface.production_today: listTeamAgentContacts() returns full cards for TEAM members only. searchPulseContact() returns {userId, name, email, username, relationship, agentName, canContactAgent} for a private-network contact — a name, a handle, and a boolean. No skills, no resources, no authority boundaries.
discovery_surface.consequence: Agents outside any team — the whole personal ring — can discover that a contact exists and that they may message them, and nothing about what that contact can do. Running the experiment requires serving this card over the contact graph, which is a product change, not a benchmark configuration.

agentCard.name: Meghan Osei's agent
agentCard.description: Owns approved internal and external messaging, media intake and public-affairs coordination. She controls message release, not the underlying clinical, privacy, security or legal determination.

skills.name: public affairs calendar
skills.description: Approved institutional messages, spokespeople and timing
examples: Ask Meghan Osei about public affairs calendar.

skills.name: media inquiries
skills.description: Reporter questions, deadlines and authorised responses
examples: Ask Meghan Osei about media inquiries.

skills.name: patient notice templates
skills.description: Approved accessible notice structures without recipient lists
examples: Ask Meghan Osei about patient notice templates.

authorityBoundaries.description: Can approve: approved public message release. May release a message after the accountable subject-matter owners approve facts and any required Privacy or Legal review is recorded.
Cannot approve breach determination — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve clinical claim approval — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve security classification — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve legal advice — route to whoever holds it.

_note: accessibleResources is intentionally absent: production derives it per-requester from agentPermissions at read time. Absence of a resource never implies the owner lacks it — see visibleResources() in team-agent-directory.ts.
